query.text: 这段视频以画面下方的玩家为拍摄视角，规定右侧是女子、左侧是男子。请告诉我谁出牌次数最多。
query.text_en: This video is filmed from the player at the bottom of the frame. The person on the right is a woman and the person on the left is a man. Please tell me who played the most cards.

annotation.text_zh: 在画面可见的出牌中，下方玩家出牌次数最多。
annotation.text_en: Among the card plays visible in the clip, the player at the bottom played most often.
